entries.title: Psalms 57:3
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Send forth - Will discover them, by affording his gracious help in pursuance of his promises.

entries.title: Psalms 57:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Lions - Fierce and bloody men. I lie - I have my abode. On fire - From hell. Who are mere fire - brands, breathing out wrath and threatenings, and incensing Saul against me.

entries.title: Psalms 57:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Excited - Glorify thy power, and goodness, and justice, and faithfulness, by my deliverance. Above, &c. - To the highest degree possible.

entries.title: Psalms 57:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Fixed - In a stedfast belief of thy promises.

entries.title: Psalms 57:8
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: My glory - My tongue, the instrument of singing. Awake - I will employ all the powers of my soul and body.

entries.title: Psalms 57:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The people - Among the Israelites, and among the Heathens, as I shall have occasion.
